description: Compares ordering a small PCB yourself (JLCPCB bare boards and Economic assembly, AISLER in Germany; fees, shipping, EU import duty and lead times read from the vendors' own pages, with links and the date checked) with having the existing build finished by Protoship. Leaves out what it does not know instead of guessing. Free, read-only.

board_mm.description: Board width and height in mm. Default [50, 50].

country.description: Two-letter EU country code of the delivery address. Default DE.

joints.description: Solder joints per board, if known.

parts_cost_usd.description: Parts cost per board in USD (from match_parts), if known.
